# Live project status

`Docs/FEATURE-PARITY.md` is the living status overview and documentation index.
Detailed status lives in its linked `Docs/Project`, `Docs/Features`,
`Docs/Compatibility`, `Docs/Engineering` and `Docs/Reference` pages.
Read `Docs/Project/DOCUMENTATION.md` for page ownership and maintenance guidance.
Keep the relevant area pages current alongside changes to application features,
core plugins, the plugin API, persistence, host capabilities or deployment.

- Update affected rows, remaining gaps and the review date for meaningful changes.
- Keep details in their area page; update the index summary when the overall position changes.
- Distinguish verified behavior from partial implementations and unaccepted work in progress.
- Update benchmark numbers only from fresh artifact-bound evidence; label older results as a historical baseline.
- Do not treat builds, enabled toggles, sample plugins or API names as proof of full Obsidian compatibility.
- Preserve the fixed core acceptance requirements and record external/browser limitations explicitly.
- Keep the README summary consistent with the live documentation.
- Keep relative links valid when adding or moving pages; each area page links back to the index.
- When working in parallel, assign non-overlapping scopes and coordinate updates to shared summaries, evidence and the core-plugin inventory.
